data.body: Investigation complete (debug-everything 2026-05-11): Confirmed — b38d-1781 (litellm ModuleNotFoundError) and related P0 bugs are already closed in this repo (per prior debug-everything session). The current CI review gate is functional. Retroactive review of PRs merged while the gate was broken (PR #49+) requires human-guided retroactive review sessions — cannot be fully automated in a single debug-everything run. Scope: check each PR from #49 to current for unreviewed code; run /dso:review on any that lack a passing review. Recommend creating a dedicated sprint for retroactive review coverage rather than attempting in debug-everything.
